ETL Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ETL Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $115,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced ETL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise-scale data integration solutions supporting business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, and cloud data modernization initiatives. This role focuses on building high-performance ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytics platforms.
You will collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts, cloud engineers, and BI developers to develop scalable data integration frameworks, automate complex workflows, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, trusted data across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong ETL development expertise with advanced SQL skills, cloud data platform experience, and a deep understanding of data warehousing and enterprise data governance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data integration projects.
  • Build scalable data ingestion workflows that extract data from relational databases, cloud applications, APIs, flat files, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop transformation logic for cleansing, standardizing, validating, and enriching large datasets.
  • Design and optimize batch and near real-time data processing pipelines supporting business-critical reporting and analytics.
  • Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), Change Data Capture (CDC), incremental loading strategies, and data reconciliation processes.
  • Develop reusable ETL frameworks, metadata-driven workflows, and parameterized jobs to improve maintainability.
  • Perform source-to-target mapping, data profiling, and data quality analysis during project implementation.
  • Optimize ETL job performance by improving SQL queries, partitioning strategies, indexing, and parallel processing.
  • Monitor ETL workflows, troubleshoot production failures, and implement proactive alerting and recovery mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to migrate legacy ETL workloads to Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Participate in data architecture discussions, code reviews, deployment planning, and production support.
  • Ensure data security, governance, auditability, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional experience developing enterprise ETL solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ETL platforms such as Informatica PowerCenter, SSIS, Talend, IBM DataStage, or Pentaho.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience designing ETL workflows involving complex transformations, joins, aggregations, lookups, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Change Data Capture (CDC), Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & Type 2), and incremental loading techniques.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms including Azure Data Factory (ADF), AWS Glue, or Google Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Experience integrating structured and semi-structured data formats including JSON, XML, CSV, Parquet, and Avro.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for ETL automation.
  • Experience scheduling workflows using Control-M, Autosys, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or enterprise schedulers.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools for ETL deployments.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and ETL performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working with Agile Scrum teams and enterprise SDLC processes.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses including Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Knowledge of Apache Spark, Databricks, PySpark, or distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality solutions.
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies including Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hub, or Amazon Kinesis.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable integration components.
  • Knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 architecture and modern data lakehouse concepts.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices for data engineering and automated ETL deployments.
  • Experience with BI platforms including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik for downstream reporting integration.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Informatica are highly desirable.

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering team responsible for modernizing data integration and analytics platforms supporting multiple business units across financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail industries. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise data warehouse modernization to Snowflake and Azure Synapse
  • Cloud-based ETL migration from legacy on-premises platforms
  • Real-time data ingestion and analytics pipelines
  • Customer 360 and Master Data Management initiatives
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data solutions
  • Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture implementation
  • Enterprise reporting platforms supporting executive dashboards and operational analytics
  • High-volume data pipelines processing billions of records from ERP, CRM, HR, and financial systems

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to data architecture, ETL development, cloud migration, performance optimization, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration solutions.

raw.title: Head of Design
raw.excerpt: Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system.
raw.description:
Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

  • Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.
  • Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.
  • Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.
  • Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.
  • Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.
  • Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.
  • Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.
  • Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.
  • Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

  • Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.
  • Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.
  • The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.
  • Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.
  • Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.
  • A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.
  • Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.
  • A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.
  • The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.
  • A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

raw.description:
Overview

Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. Our overarching goal is to end homelessness among youth and young families by helping them achieve housing stability, heal from trauma, tap into their innate resilience, and hone their interests and skills to forge new pathways to independence. This work is carried out across Covenant House sites in 34 cities in the US, Canada, Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras.

About the Role

The Senior Vice President, Foundation Relations is a strategic and entrepreneurial fundraising executive responsible for leading Covenant House International's foundation fundraising program and securing transformational philanthropic investments from private foundations. Reporting directly to the Chief Philanthropy Officer, the SVP will focus primarily on identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding major commitments from foundations capable of making seven- and eight-figure investments.

The SVP will expand Covenant House's foundation portfolio by developing and securing significant new funding relationships with international, national, regional, family, and private foundations whose priorities align with Covenant House's mission and strategic objectives. The successful candidate will be a proven fundraiser with extensive experience securing multiple multi-million-dollar commitments and multi-year grants from leading private foundations.

This leader will manage a team of frontline foundation relations officers and grant writers responsible for prospect development, cultivation, proposal development, reporting, and ongoing foundation engagement. The SVP will establish ambitious revenue goals, implement best practices across the foundation relations function, and build a high-performing team capable of sustaining significant growth.

As a senior leader within the revenue organization, the SVP will help shape fundraising strategy, foster cross-functional collaboration, and model Covenant House's values of unconditional love, absolute respect, and relentless support. This position requires a self-starter with exceptional judgment, initiative, and accountability who can operate independently and achieve ambitious goals with minimal supervision.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Foundation Fundraising Strategy and Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive foundation relations strategy focused on securing transformational seven- and eight-figure investments from international, national, regional, family, and private foundations

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of high-capacity foundation prospects capable of making significant multi-year commitments

  • Personally manage a portfolio of the organization's most significant foundation prospects and funders

  • Identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward new foundation partners whose philanthropic priorities align with Covenant House's mission and strategic plan

  • Develop strategies to secure support for core operations, programmatic initiatives, capital projects, endowment opportunities, international programs, policy initiatives, and other strategic priorities

  • Lead complex funding discussions and negotiate major grant awards and multi-year commitments

  • Establish annual revenue goals and performance metrics for the foundation relations program

  • Monitor trends in institutional philanthropy and identify emerging opportunities for strategic foundation investments

Foundation Relationship Management

  • Build trusted relationships with foundation presidents, executive directors, trustees, program officers, philanthropic advisors, and family office representatives

  • Design and implement customized cultivation and stewardship strategies for major foundation funders

  • Coordinate foundation site visits, executive briefings, funder meetings, and strategic engagement opportunities

  • Ensure exceptional stewardship and grant reporting that demonstrates impact and strengthens long-term relationships

  • Position Covenant House as a preferred philanthropic partner among leading foundations nationwide

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of foundation relations professionals, including frontline foundation relations officers and grant writers

  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and professional development plans

  • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture centered on excellence, innovation, results, and continuous learning

  • Create systems and processes that improve proposal development, grant management, prospect tracking, and foundation stewardship

  • Ensure effective coordination between frontline fundraising activities and grant writing functions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with colleagues across donor relations, corporate partnerships, affiliate relations, marketing and communications, finance, programs, and executive leadership.

  • Coordinate institution-wide strategies involving major funding opportunities that require collaboration across multiple departments and subject-matter experts.

  • Work closely with program leaders to develop compelling cases for support and foundation funding opportunities.

  • Collaborate with donor relations colleagues when foundation trustees, family members, or family offices present opportunities for individual major gifts.

  • Partner with corporate partnerships colleagues when foundations and corporate philanthropy initiatives overlap.

  • Engage executive leadership and board members in cultivation and solicitation efforts when appropriate.

Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as a key member of the revenue organization leadership team and contribute to overall fundraising strategy and organizational growth.

  • Represent Covenant House with credibility and professionalism among foundation leaders and external stakeholders.

  • Model Covenant House's values and demonstrate a commitment to mission-centered leadership.

  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, integrity, inclusion, and shared success

  • Provide strategic insights regarding philanthropy trends, institutional funding opportunities, and long-term revenue diversification

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep expertise in foundation fundraising and institutional philanthropy

  • Strong understanding of the foundation landscape, including major family, independent, regional, national, and international foundations

  • Proven ability to identify, cultivate, and close new foundation funding relationships

  • Expertise in developing comprehensive institutional fundraising strategies aligned with organizational priorities

  • Exceptional relationship-building skills with foundation executives, trustees, program officers, and philanthropic advisors

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities

  • Ability to develop and communicate complex cases for support tailored to institutional funders

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proposal development skills

  • Outstanding presentation and verbal communication abilities

  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

  • Strong understanding of grant budgeting, proposal development, compliance, stewardship, and reporting requirements

  • High degree of initiative, accountability, and independent judgment

  • Strong project management and organizational skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines within a fast-paced environment

  • Passion for Covenant House's mission and demonstrated commitment to serving vulnerable youth

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 12-15 years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial experience in foundation relations and institutional giving

  • Demonstrated success securing seven- and eight-figure grants and multi-year commitments from private foundations

  • Proven success securing seven- and eight-figure grants from national, regional, family, and private foundations

  • Experience building and managing portfolios of major foundation prospects and funders

  • Significant experience developing new foundation partnerships and generating substantial new revenue

  • Demonstrated success leading foundation fundraising strategies that achieve sustained revenue growth

  • Experience managing frontline fundraising professionals and grant writing teams.

  • Experience collaborating with executive leaders, board members, program staff, and external stakeholders

  • Experience managing large funding opportunities involving multiple stakeholders and organizational departments

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and consistently achieve ambitious fundraising goals with minimal supervision

  • Ability and willingness to travel as necessary

Expected Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Fundraising Leadership

  • Foundation Relations Expertise

  • New Business Development

  • Executive Presence

  • Revenue Growth Mindset

  • Talent Development and Coaching

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Innovation and Opportunity Creation

  • Influence and Relationship Building

  • Results Orientation

  • Accountability and Ownership

  • Mission-Driven Leadership

  • Financial Stewardship

  • Sound Judgment and Decision-Making

Travel Requirements

  • Expected to travel nationally up to 10%-30% for in-person meetings with partners and CHI team meetings as needed

Our Community

Our critical mission demands that we have all voices at the table. A team of diverse people, perspectives, and experiences is smarter, stronger, and more effective for our young people. At Covenant House, every team member is valued, respected, heard, and supported, and we welcome honest and courageous self-reflection on any aspects of our work that are based on biased or outdated viewpoints. We deliberately create opportunities for our staff to grow and thrive.

All employment decisions at CHI are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, family or parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Dear Copywriter:

We are seeking a talented and passionate copywriter to join our dynamic team. As a copywriter in our digital marketing company, you will be responsible for crafting high-quality, attention-grabbing long and short form copy that drives quantifiable results.

If you're someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and can produce high volumes of work while meeting tight deadlines, then we want you on our team!

If you’re “chomping at the bit” for a chance to make a name for yourself by selling REAL products to REAL consumers at a massive scale…

And you’re sick and tired of working for penny-pinching clients who “don’t get it,” while feeling forever clueless as to how you’ll pay next month’s rent…

Yet you have ZERO interest in relocating to New Jersey to work in-office at a Direct Response Marketing Agency..

Then this unique opportunity is for you.

But before we get to the details…

Here’s what you can expect while working with us:

Get Trained By The Best In The World: As soon as you join our team, you’ll get signed up for Stefan Georgi’s “Copy and Funnel Accelerator.” Each week, you’ll learn from the best copywriters and marketers in the world. Yet even better, you’ll have a REAL business and REAL customers to test these strategies on.

Become A Titan of Direct Response: If you make it through the initial 30-Day Trial Period, you’ll not only supercharge your copywriting chops, but you’ll also see the inside of multiple 7-figure direct response advertising agencies. This means you’ll become a master in understanding how to maximize AOVs, work with clients, manage videographers/designers, and so much more (while elevating your status from “just another copywriter” to a fully-trained “Marketing Master” in the process).

Intrigued?

Great, you should be.

Requirements

Here are the facts though, this opportunity is not for everyone.

To respect everyone’s time, you should only apply if you meet the following criteria:

  • You’re a damn-good writer who captures attention and compels your readers to ACT NOW with clear writing.
  • You are an extremely creative and original storyteller.
  • You can write high volume (over 1,000 words a day) and handle multiple projects at the same time.
  • You are a ruthless self-learner always striving to improve your craft.
  • You understand that the rules of grammar are mere “suggestions” that exist to be ignored.
  • You have the knowledge and/or experience with long-form sales letters, video sales letters, advertorials, and tried-and-true conversion tactics.
  • You’re not afraid of research. You understand the best marketing ideas do not magically appear, but rather they’re found through digging in and researching the topic.
  • You are highly responsible, organized, and deadline-oriented.
  • You’re flexible, adaptable, and open to constantly changing methods, objectives, and environments.
  • You are open to constructive criticism when it comes to your copy.

Responsibilities:
  • Long Form Video Sales Letters when needed. Some clients will need a long form VSL written when they come in and you'll write a new one for them.
  • YouTube Video Ad Scripts: We are very well known for our YouTube Ad Services, and that starts with your ability to write scripts that get the attention of the prospect, pre-sell them on clicking on the ad, and then get them to convert on the next page.
  • Facebook Video Ad Scripts: Writing high-converting Video Ads for Facebook, while keeping compliance top of mind, so our clients do not get their ad account shut down.
  • Communicate With Clients: You will talk with clients about their customer avatar, their product, and their market, and use this information to create scripts for their ads
  • Maintain Weekly Log / Report of Ad Results: You will be expected to work with our stats team to see how many winning scripts we are writing every single week
  • Research: You will be expected to do research for each client we take on, diving into their niche, product, competitors and more.
  • Facebook Ad Image Ads: You will work with our design team to get the correct image ads created based upon the copy you are writing for that product

Day-to-Day

Here's what some of your day-to-day work might look like...

  • Our client in the Amazon FBA Training space needs to bump up their click-through rate on YouTube to over 1.5%, so we need 4 new scripts written."
  • We have a new client in the dog training space, we have identified they need new copy for their first upsell and will need to write a 12-minute upsell on how to potty train their puppy. We need this done over the next 10 days"
  • We need 10 short-form TikTok scripts done for a new client in the Medicare Lead Gen space. These will be more about the hooks than anything."
  • Re-write this client's front-end VSL, it's currently only 2 minutes long, and we need an 8 minute VSL to fully presell their event"
  • These tasks will all come through Asana, where everyone will have a full brief, deadline attached, and be fully managed by the creative head.

Benefits

You will get to work with some of the best media buyers, marketers, and business professionals in the world.

This position is for someone who wants to be pushed to be in the top 1% of copywriters, be trained by the best, and ultimately progress at a level they’ve never been to.

Your copy will literally be tested right after you write it, and it will go out to Millions of people across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, & Google. You will be able to see what works extremely fast, no more wondering if your copy ‘did well’.

Disclaimer:

  • This is an Entry Level Position
  • The pay range is between $25,000 - $30,000 p.a. The pay range may vary based on your experience.
  • We are looking for people with 1-2 years of industry experience.

We've built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over 60,000 documents per month through a network of about 2,000 contracted process servers. We're working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it's traditionally been.

About the Role

Proof's Creditors Rights business is scaling quickly, and we're looking for a builder to own delivery end-to-end. As Senior Director, Creditors Rights Service & Delivery, you'll build and run the teams responsible for discovery, scoping, implementation, and filing across every new and expanding account. This is a build-and-run role: you'll define the operating model as much as you execute against it, working hands-on while the function is still taking shape. It's a chance to build the infrastructure behind a high-growth, mission-critical part of our business from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • You'll own remote discovery, scoping, and implementation for all new and expansion Creditors Rights accounts.
  • You'll serve as the subject matter expert for Creditors Rights service delivery, translating legal and procedural nuance into scalable operational process.
  • You'll design, document, and continuously refine the end-to-end workflow, from discovery through scoping, implementation, and filing.
  • You'll own remote research into new suit and affidavit filing requirements, keeping pace with jurisdictional and procedural changes.
  • You'll build the infrastructure (workflows, tooling, documentation, training) needed to take the business from foundational to scaled.
  • You'll establish quality control, SLAs, and productivity benchmarks for a function that's still being built.
  • You'll partner directly with Sales on new business handoffs, setting clear scoping and expectations from the start.
  • You'll own the third-party vendor-managed filing relationship, including performance, quality, and escalation management.
  • You'll manage caseload and client escalations directly when needed. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely oversight one.
  • You'll report on delivery performance, bottlenecks, and scaling readiness to senior leadership.
  • You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Litigation Support, Server Network, other Service Delivery pillars, and Product/Tech to align Creditors Rights into the broader operating model.

What You'll Bring

  • Deep subject matter expertise in Creditors Rights practice and procedure (discovery, scoping, filing requirements, jurisdictional nuance).
  • Proven experience building operational process from scratch, comfortable operating without a fully mature playbook.
  • A track record leading and scaling delivery teams in a legal services, legal tech, or similar operations environment.
  • Experience managing third-party vendor relationships tied to filing or similar operational delivery.
  • Comfortable operating in a matrixed structure, including managing a dotted-line technical resource jointly with Product/Tech.
  • Strong project and process design skills, able to both architect a scalable model and execute against it personally.
  • High tolerance for ambiguity and a bias toward action (this role isn't suited to a purely strategic operator).
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales on new business implementation.

raw.description:
About Us
Marie Curie is the UK’s leading end-of-life charity. We are the largest non-NHS provider of end-of-life care in the UK, the only provider across all 4 nations, delivering community nursing and hospice care across the country, while providing information and support on all aspects of dying, death, and bereavement. Our leading research pushes the boundaries of what we know about good end-of-life, and our campaigns fight for a world where everyone gets to have the best possible quality of life while living with an illness, they are likely to die from.

The care and support we provide is highly valued by the people we care for and their loved ones, but at present we are only reaching around 10% of dying people at the end of life. Right now, one in four people in the UK with a terminal illness, do not get the care or support they deserve at the end of their lives.

We want a different society than the one we live in now. Our mission for the next five years is to close the gap in the number of people missing out on what they need at the end-of-life

raw.description:
About Us

Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We're a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian.

We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world's largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences.

The Opportunity

You won't be building from the sidelines. As a Modus Database Engineer embedded in our Modus Data & ML practice, you operate as a forward deployed engineer — right at the frontier of enterprise data transformation. You'll work directly with clients to accelerate pre-sales opportunities, collaborating with Sellers, to turn data challenges into production-grade solutions.

Our team drives database migration, modernization, and platform engineering for some of the largest organizations in the world — helping them Re-host on AWS EC2, Re-platform to RDS, Re-factor to Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL/NoSQL, and migrate Oracle/Exadata workloads to ODB@AWS. You'll be in the room (or the call) where it happens, turning ambiguity into architectures and architectures into outcomes.

This isn't a role for people who want to sit back and review tickets. You'll lead Executive Conversations, drive proof-of-concepts, run technical workshops, and build reusable IP that multiplies impact across customers, market segments, and technology domains. If you thrive on complexity, love building scalable patterns, and want your work to directly shape enterprise deals and client outcomes — this is your seat.

What you'll do

  • Lead technical pre-sales engagements — Executive Conversations, workshops, POCs — directly alongside Seller turning ambiguous client challenges into validated technical solutions.
  • Architect and deliver database migration strategies across the full modernization spectrum: Re-host (EC2), Re-platform (RDS), Re-factor (Aurora PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB), and Oracle/Exadata to ODB@AWS migrations.
  • Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and translate them into scalable, reusable architectural IP — including GenAI-enabled database migration accelerators.
  • Deconstruct complex technical propositions into clear, repeatable solutions that sales teams can execute and clients can trust.
  • Gather market segment data and build business cases that bridge the gap between current-state infrastructure and the outcomes clients actually care about.
  • Influence senior technical and business stakeholders — inside and outside the client organization — as a credible, independent voice on data modernization strategy.
  • Drive force-multiplication: create mechanisms, enablement assets, and documentation that scale your impact well beyond your direct engagements.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams in a fully distributed, asynchronous-first environment.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with database migration and modernization projects — ideally involving AWS data services (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, DMS, SCT).
  • Deep proficiency in one or more relational database platforms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server — including schema design, query optimization, and replication.
  • Proven ability to architect and implement data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and integration patterns at scale.
  • Experience with Oracle or Exadata migrations — including assessment, schema conversion, and cutover planning — is strongly valued.
  • Solid understanding of AWS infrastructure fundamentals: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and compute/storage considerations for database workloads.
  • Comfort operating in pre-sales and client-facing contexts — you can translate technical depth into business language without losing the signal.
  • Ability to lead proof-of-concept engagements end-to-end: scope, build, validate, and present results to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals — you write clean, maintainable code and understand how data engineering fits into broader application architectures.
  • Experience working in distributed, async-first teams; you don't need to be in the same timezone to drive outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with NoSQL platforms: DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar — especially in migration or modernization contexts.
  • Familiarity with GenAI-assisted data migration tooling, LLM-powered schema translation, or AI-driven data quality workflows.
  • AWS certifications (Database Specialty, Solutions Architect, or Data Analytics).
  • Experience with data lakehouse architectures, Apache Iceberg, Glue, or Athena.
    Background in consulting, professional services, or solutions engineering — you know how to run a room.
  • Contributions to open-source data tooling, migration frameworks, or reusable architectural patterns.

You'll Love

  • Being the technical voice in the room — not just a builder in the back, but a strategic force in enterprise deals.Working at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and generative AI on problems that actually matter at scale.
  • Building reusable IP that outlives individual engagements and shapes how entire market segments modernize their data platforms.
  • Collaborating with Fortune 500 clients, and a globally distributed team of sharp, low-ego engineers.
  • The autonomy to define solutions, the support to deliver them, and the recognition when they land.

By joining our team, you'll be part of a group that values precision, honest communication, and delivering work that stands up to scrutiny. Apply now and show us you've got what it takes to build data platforms that matter.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach thousands of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for solving complex challenges and driving meaningful impact for patients, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team.

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. As a global biotechnology leader, we collaborate across disciplines to deliver innovative therapies that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

Live

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.

The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based patient access and reimbursement specialist responsible for supporting patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and sites of care in navigating insurance coverage and reimbursement pathways for Amgen therapies.

The PAL serves as a key resource in helping stakeholders understand payer requirements, prior authorization processes, reimbursement considerations, and available patient support resources. The role focuses on ensuring timely and sustained access to therapy by addressing reimbursement barriers and providing education to patients and providers on coverage and financial assistance programs.

Working within a collaborative field environment, the PAL partners with internal teams including Market Access, Medical Affairs, Advocacy, Marketing, Case Management, and Site of Care teams to support the patient journey. The role operates with independence in managing assigned patient cases and contributes field insights that inform broader access strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Access and Reimbursement Support

  • Serve as a resource on patient access and reimbursement for infused and specialty therapies.

  • Assist patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers in navigating insurance benefits, prior authorization requirements, and reimbursement processes.

  • Support the identification and resolution of access challenges, including coverage questions, prior authorization barriers, and denied claims.

  • Provide education regarding coding and billing considerations relevant to therapy access.

Patient and Caregiver Engagement

  • Develop relationships with patients and caregivers through phone, virtual, and in-person engagement.

  • Secure written or electronic patient HIPAA authorization within assigned geography.

  • Assess individual patient needs and provide education and resources that support access to therapy.

  • Educate patients on coverage considerations and the steps required to obtain prior authorization.

  • Provide information regarding co-pay assistance programs, national foundations, and free drug programs when appropriate.

Provider and Site-of-Care Education

  • Educate physician offices and sites of care on therapy coverage pathways and reimbursement processes.

  • Provide information regarding common prior authorization requirements, coding considerations, and billing practices.

  • Support healthcare providers and infusion centers in navigating reimbursement questions related to patient cases.

Access Issue Resolution

  • Investigate patient access challenges before and after infusion.

  • Support physician offices and sites of care in reviewing denied claims and identifying potential next steps.

  • Escalate complex or systemic reimbursement issues to appropriate internal stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal stakeholders including Market Access, Medical Affairs, Advocacy, Case Managers, and Site of Care teams to support patient access initiatives.

  • Coordinate with internal and external partners to ensure appropriate resources are available to support patient access.

  • Share field insights regarding payer policies and reimbursement challenges.

Compliance, Safety, and Operational Excellence

  • Adhere to company policies, compliance guidance, and applicable to federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Ensure activities align with HIPAA privacy requirements and internal compliance guidelines.

  • Report adverse events and product complaints through established pharmacovigilance processes.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of activities and interactions in Amgen’s internal system.

Win

What we expect of you

Basic Qualifications - Level 5

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of patient services and/or access and reimbursement experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of patient services and/or access and reimbursement experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 8 years of patient services and/or access and reimbursement experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 10 years of patient services and/or access and reimbursement experience

Basic Qualifications - Level 6

Doctorate degree and 2 years of patient services, and/or access and reimbursement, experience

OR

Master's degree and 4 years of patient services, and/or access and reimbursement, experience

OR

Bachelor's degree and 6 years of patient services, and/or access and reimbursement, experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting buy-and-bill or infused pharmaceutical therapies

  • Rare disease or orphan drug experience

  • Clinical background such as nursing or allied health

  • Understanding of reimbursement processes including prior authorization, appeals, and denied claims management

  • Knowledge of HIPAA guidelines and FDA regulatory requirements

  • Familiarity with internal and OIG compliance guidelines

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to manage complex patient situations and resolve access barriers

  • Experience working in cross-functional field teams

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM, AI and relevant systems

  • Access and reimbursement knowledge

  • Prior authorization processes

  • Healthcare reimbursement systems

  • Coding and billing awareness

  • Patient support program knowledge

  • Compliance and privacy requirements

  • Learning agility

  • Decision quality

  • Stakeholder engagement

  • Ability to respond rapidly to urgent access needs to prevent treatment delays or lapses

  • Ability to operate effectively in matrix field environments

  • Travel up to 50%, including occasional overnight and weekend commitments

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

The annual base salary range is from $158,394 -$185,578 for Level 5 , $164,276 - $ 222,256 for Level 6. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In this role, you will lead the creation, organization, and maintenance of program documentation for the Medicare Part A, B and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) contracts, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and compliance across a complex systems environment.

This role plays a critical part in capturing system functionality, documenting architecture and interfaces, and supporting the program through high-quality technical artifacts. The Technical Writer will work closely with engineering, development, and operations teams to ensure all documentation reflects current system behavior and meets contractual requirements at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

Responsibilities

  • Develops, updates, and maintains comprehensive technical documentation for the DME program, including System Architecture Diagrams, Interface Catalogs, Data Dictionaries, User Guides, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and operational runbooks.
  • Ensures all documentation is revised and published within 10 business days of system updates, enhancements, or changes, in accordance with contract requirements.
  • Establishes, implements, and enforces documentation standards, templates, version controls, and style guidelines to ensure consistency and quality across all program artifacts.
  • Maintains and organizes a centralized document repository; ensures documentation is properly tagged, archived, and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
  • Collaborates closely with architects, developers, engineers, analysts, and operational staff to collect accurate information, validate updates, and ensure documentation reflects the current system state.
  • Translates complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and user-friendly documentation tailored for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Conducts periodic audits of documentation to identify gaps, misalignments, or outdated content, and coordinates corrective updates with relevant teams.
  • Supports the creation of internal and external communication materials, including onboarding documentation, training materials, release notes, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Assists with compliance documentation and artifact preparation for reviews, audits, and program deliverables.
  • Participates in Agile ceremonies and release planning sessions to anticipate and plan for upcoming documentation needs.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, Information Technology, Computer Science, English, or a related discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience; or a High School diploma with 6+ years of directly relevant experience.
  • 2–5 years of experience developing and maintaining technical documentation within an IT, software development, or systems engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated experience creating system-level documentation such as architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data dictionaries, and user guides.
  • Strong ability to interpret technical information from SMEs, engineers, and system artifacts and translate it into clear, accurate documentation.
  • Experience managing a documentation repository using tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Git-based platforms, or similar systems.
  • Proficiency with documentation, diagramming, and collaboration tools includingMicrosoft Office Suite, Visio, Lucidchart, Confluence, and Jira.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy across multiple concurrent documents.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Must be able to achieve and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • US Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government programs or working within a highly regulated environment.
  • Experience with Medicare DME, Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, or the Medicare Common Working File (CWF) specific processing systems.
  • Experience working with or in support of CMS programs or contracts.
  • Familiarity with Agile or SAFe methodologies and participation in Agile Scrum teams.
  • Experience documenting system integrations involving legacy mainframe systems, cloud environments, or hybrid architectures.
  • Working knowledge of claims processing systems, enterprise data flows, or large-scale system maintenance efforts.
  • Experience applying formal documentation standards such as style guides, templates, and terminology catalogs.
  • Familiarity with GitHub or similar source code management and collaboration tools.
  • Ability to develop visuals and technical diagrams using industry-standard tools.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

CRA II

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

raw.excerpt: About Gordon Brothers:Since 1903, Gordon Brothers has helped companies unlock the potential of their assets.
raw.description:
About Gordon Brothers:Since 1903, Gordon Brothers has helped companies unlock the potential of their assets. Our solutions-oriented approach combined with over 120 years of industry knowledge enables clients to get the most value from their assets with tailored solutions across asset services, asset lending and financing, and asset trading. Leveraging our deep expertise in retail, industrial, brands and real estate, we work closely with clients globally to determine the value of, lend against, or buy and sell their assets to help them achieve their business goals.At Gordon Brothers, we foster a culture of collaboration and creativity to find unique and innovative solutions for our clients. We take pride in fostering an engaging, inclusive culture and encouraging employees to bring new ideas to the table, develop their skills, and build dynamic and fulfilling careers.For more information, please visit www.gordonbrothers.com.

Description

Gordon Brothers’ comprehensive recovery and restructuring solutions manage complex programmes across multiple asset classes.

We provide full-service solutions across machinery and business assets, inventory, intellectual property and real estate providing rapid and effective outcomes for clients at every stage of the business cycle.

The Appraiser is responsible for managing all aspects of preparing valuations, will interact with clients, and will manage the project team, which may include analysts and writers, in order to meet specified deadlines. The Appraiser will conduct appraisals under the supervision and review of a Manager.

In this role, you will:

  • Use and apply internal models to appraise various industries and projects.
  • Conduct appraisals independently in coordination with the project reviewer.
  • Make efficient travel arrangements (air, land, and hotel accommodations) by appropriately approximating inspection duration and logically planning the most efficient travel routes and accommodations.
  • Determine the proper questions to ask in interviews in order to obtain relevant information for appraising needs consistent with the guidelines in the inventory procedures.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of what to look for in the inspection process and how to collect the information needed to conduct an inventory appraisal.
  • Conduct on-site interviews or telephone interviews to become familiar with a company’s operations, control and management procedures, inventory makeup, and factors that will affect inventory values.
  • Document inspection notes properly.
  • Proactively identify any challenges with values up front and communicate issues/concerns to the client and Business Development Officer well in advance of the final report issuance.
  • Supervise Analysts and Senior Analysts in the research process and review their work.
  • Measure the financial performance and operational metrics of appraised companies, including detailed inventory and sales analysis, expenses structures, seasonality trends, inventory turnover, and gross margin analysis. Review and contribute to the narrative of appraisal reports.
  • Participate in project reviews with senior management.
  • Communicate directly with all clients and uphold a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Confidently and concisely communicate to a company and/or client the rationale for changes in value or defend values for a new appraisal.
  • Maintain the Gordon Brothers’ Appraisal Application database to ensure accurate and timely contact, company, and project information.
  • Uphold Gordon Brothers’ Core Values and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the strategic plan.

The ideal candidate will have the following:

  • The position requires a Bachelor of Business Administration or Bachelor of Science in a related field or equivalent experience. A concentration in business, finance, accounting, or economics is preferred.
  • Up to three years of and/or analyst experience is desired.
  • Achievement of two or more classes towards certification from a chosen professional society is preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with computer applications in a Microsoft Windows-based environment. Advanced proficiency with MS Excel and MS Word is required. A working knowledge of MS PowerPoint is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required.
  • Maintaining a high degree of integrity and business acumen is required.
  • Demonstrated analytical, presentation, and project management skills are desired.
  • Use of problem-solving capabilities to look in-depth at information pertaining to a job is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to spread historical financial statement data, including income statement and balance sheet is preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to thrive in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment handling multiple projects is essential.

Gordon Brothers offers a competitive total compensation package including base salary and incentive plan, benefits allowance and more.

Gordon Brothers is an equal opportunity employer and strongly supports diversity in the workplace. This Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.

It is the policy of Gordon Brothers to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. Reasonable accommodation is available for qualified individuals with disabilities, upon request.

In compliance with the Equality Act 2010, please contact the Human Resources department if you have a disability and need reasonable accommodation with any part the application process. Requests will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

raw.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership across product areas. You will shape architecture, guide complex engineering initiatives, and help teams deliver scalable, secure, and reliable software.

This remote role is based in USA/Canada and requires strong collaboration across distributed engineering, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of scalable, secure, highly available systems and platforms.
    - Define architectural direction, engineering standards, and technical best practices across teams.
    - Drive large technical initiatives such as modernization, cloud transformation, platform scalability, and developer productivity improvements.
    - Lead technical planning, design reviews, and risk mitigation for cross-team initiatives.
    - Partner with Product Management, Engineering Managers, Architects, and stakeholders to turn business goals into sustainable technical solutions.
    - Mentor engineers and strengthen technical leadership, design practices, and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    - 10+ years of professional software development experience, including leadership of technical initiatives.
    - Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and C# in enterprise-scale applications.
    - Experience designing distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native solutions.
    - Strong AWS and/or Azure experience, including security, observability, automation, and production operations.
    - Experience with GitHub Actions, DevOps practices, and Terraform.
    - Deep understanding of scalability, performance, resilience, and reliability engineering.
    - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating production AI/LLM-enabled applications, such as model integrations, evaluation frameworks, or AI-assisted developer tooling.
    - Experience with highly available SaaS production systems.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Intelex

Since 1992, Intelex Technologies, ULC. is a global leader in the development and support of software solutions for Environment, Health, Safety and Quality (EHSQ) programs. Our scalable, web-based software provides clients with unprecedented flexibility in managing, tracking and reporting on essential corporate information. Intelex software easily integrates with common ERP systems like SAP and PeopleSoft creating a seamless solution for enterprise-wide information management. Intelex’s friendly, knowledgeable staff ensures our almost 1400 clients and over 3.5 million users from companies across the globe get the most out of our groundbreaking, user-friendly software solutions. Visit www.intelex.com to learn more.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .

Bonus or Equity
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

Pay Range
The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 137,200.00 - 229,100.00

  • Conduct solution discovery and value presentations across Workiva's core solutions, including Financial Reporting, GRC and Sustainability

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of related career experience in pre-sales/solution consulting or management consulting experience (e.g., Big 4 or equivalent) with a background in solution consulting, technical sales, or solution delivery

Preferred Qualifications

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary

The Enterprise Risk Analytics & Reporting Sr Analyst supports enterprise risk reporting, dashboards, and data visualizations used for Executive Management and Board-level committee oversight. This role partners with Risk Management and first line stakeholders to translate data and reporting needs into clear, accurate, and actionable insights. The position helps strengthen enterprise risk reporting through data validation, reporting automation, documentation, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement of reporting solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support the development of quarterly risk committee reporting packages, including the creation, update, and enhancement of data visualizations that communicate key risk trends and insights for Executive Management/Board-level committee oversight.

  • Translate stakeholder reporting and data visualization requirements into new or enhanced dashboards, reports, and visualizations within Archer, Power BI, or other reporting platforms; proactively identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, automation, and insight beyond initial stakeholder requests. Stakeholders include both second line and first line of defense partners.

  • Perform recurring data validation, table refreshes, and reporting data quality checks to support accurate, complete, and timely reporting outputs. Coordinate with Data Engineering and other technical partners to troubleshoot data issues, support source system or table updates, and improve ETL processes, data model refreshes, and recurring data workflows to enhance reporting reliability, efficiency, and scalability.

  • Provide stakeholder education, reporting guidance, and ongoing support to promote effective use and understanding of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations; respond to reporting questions, troubleshoot issues, and help stakeholders interpret data outputs and insights.

  • Document reporting actions, design decisions, processes, controls, and overall strategy to support transparency, continuity, and repeatability; maintain clear documentation that enables others to understand, support, or replicate reporting and data visualization approaches.

  • It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Data Science / Analytics, or a related field

Minimum Experience

  • 3 to 5 years or greater of banking, enterprise risk management, operational risk, data analytics, reporting, or related experience

  • Experience developing and modifying reports, dashboards, data models, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting platforms

  • Experience working with large datasets, multiple source systems, and recurring reporting routines

  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, including report management, data fields, layouts, or related configuration preferred

  • Experience in financial services, banking, or another regulated industry preferred

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data accuracy, completeness, and reporting detail

  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, concise insights

  • Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI and Excel

  • Working knowledge of SQL, Power Query, DAX, Snowflake, or comparable reporting and data management tools

  • Ability to establish, follow, and document recurring reporting routines, controls, and governance standards across multiple stakeholders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of Management

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Demands

  • Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels

  • Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor

  • Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time

  • Ability to bend and reach

Work Environment

  • Office: If the position reports to a physical Company location, the setting will be a typical office environment.

  • Remote or hybrid: For remote or hybrid positions, a secure and distraction-free setting is required, with a reliable internet connection (cable or fiber preferred, mobile hotspots not acceptable). Hybrid positions will report to a physical Company location, as directed by the manager, and that setting will be a typical office environment.
