raw.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren Solution Architect die de architecturale richting bepaalt voor nieuwe en bestaande digitale platformen. Je vertaalt businessnoden en richtinggevende requirements naar veilige, schaalbare, duurzame en kostenefficiënte solution architectures, en begeleidt de realisatie ervan van analyse tot oplevering.

Je bent betrokken vanaf de requirementsanalyse en het ontwerp tot en met architectuurreviews, implementatiebegeleiding en, waar relevant, blueprintfases van nieuwe initiatieven.

  • Je brengt requirements in kaart en prioriteert ze samen met business- en technische stakeholders.
  • Je werkt cloud-native solution architectures, oplossingsscenario’s en realistische architectuurroadmaps uit voor complexe digitale platformen.
  • Je evalueert architectuurvarianten op basis van kwaliteit, risico’s, aannames, trade-offs en Total Cost of Ownership.
  • Je documenteert belangrijke architectuurbeslissingen in Architectural Decision Records.
  • Je modelleert architectuur en maakt die begrijpelijk voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
  • Je stemt project- en changearchitecturen af op de bestaande en toekomstige enterprise-architectuur.
  • Je begeleidt ontwikkelteams tijdens de gefaseerde realisatie en voert architectuurreviews uit.
  • Je bewaakt de samenhang, bouwbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid, veiligheid, kostenefficiëntie en duurzaamheid van de oplossingen.
  • Je past security by design toe doorheen de volledige software development lifecycle.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je bent een specialist architect in een specifiek domein, zoals netwerking, veiligheid, serverinfrastructuur, applicatiearchitectuur, ERP, ECM-platformen, datawarehouse en BI, of je hebt het profiel van enterprise architect.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitwerken van cloud-native solution architectures voor complexe digitale platformen.
  • Je beheerst modelleertechnieken en tools zoals ArchiMate, TOGAF, UML en Sparx EA.
  • Je hebt architecturale ervaring met .NET Core en/of Java/Kotlin en voldoende technische breedte om over meerdere technologiestacks heen te ontwerpen.
  • Je kent Structurizr, het C4-model en/of Architectural Decision Records.
  • Je hebt kennis van Vue.js of een vergelijkbare moderne front-endarchitectuur.
  • Je begrijpt bedrijfsprocessen in hun bredere context.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met projectmanagementaspecten zoals kosten, timing, coördinatie, planning en schattingen.
  • Je combineert brede kennis over verschillende domeinen met bewezen expertise in minstens één specialisatiedomein, zoals infrastructuur, applicatie, beveiliging, data of proces.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van ontwikkelteams en het uitvoeren van architectuurreviews.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van informatiebeveiliging en ervaring met security-by-designprincipes.
  • Extra troeven zijn kennis van 12-factor-appprincipes en hexagonale of clean architecture, ervaring in een data-intensieve of gereguleerde omgeving en/of een relevante architectuur- of cloudcertificering.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Product Manager to lead our Player Account Management (PAM) system initiatives in the fast-paced iGaming industry. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of PAM systems and a passion for creating exceptional player experiences.

Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.

About This Role:

As a Software Engineer for Network Architecture and SDN at TeraWave, you contribute technical expertise to the design and implementation of the network that operates our multi-orbit constellation of 5,408 optically interconnected satellites. You develop a dynamic, self-healing network that functions at orbital speeds, supporting inter-satellite links that move at 27,000 km/h and seamless handoffs for users on the ground, all within strict power and latency budgets. You apply expertise in networking architecture and software-defined networking to build critical components of our space-based communications system. You collaborate with principal engineers and technical leaders on routing, traffic management, and network resilience, and you mentor junior engineers on networking best practices.

In this role, you will apply your strong expertise in networking architecture and software-defined networking to develop critical components of our space-based communications system. You will collaborate with principal engineers, senior software developers, and technical leaders to implement innovative approaches to routing, traffic management, and network resilience. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced communications technology and orbital mechanics, making significant technical contributions to a revolutionary system.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop routing solutions, topology management, and fast-reroute mechanisms tailored for time-varying LEO satellite constellations.

  • Implement software-defined networking frameworks that support centralized and distributed control planes across the constellation.

  • Implement self-healing network logic where real-time telemetry drives automated congestion management and fault isolation.

  • Develop observability components using in-band and out-of-band telemetry for packet-level visibility and flow-level tracing.

  • Implement packet forwarding solutions that operate reliably in space, optimizing latency and throughput under power constraints.

  • Support cross-layer optimization with RF and Silicon teams to ensure mobility across beams and satellites.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Five or more years of experience in software development for networks, distributed systems, or telecommunications.

  • Experience implementing SDN controllers and programmable data planes such as P4, OpenFlow, or proprietary frameworks.

  • Experience implementing network solutions for wireless, cloud, or service provider networks.

  • Experience developing software for mission-critical systems in production environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Experience with satellite communications networks or terrestrial and satellite hybrid networks.

  • Knowledge of BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, and Segment Routing (SRv6 or SR-MPLS) in production network environments.

  • Understanding of packet processing, ASIC or FPGA forwarding logic, and high-speed switching.

  • Background in graph theory or network optimization, with modeling and simulation tools for network performance analysis.

  • Contributions to networking projects, internally or open-source, and understanding of regulatory considerations for communications systems.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical written and verbal communication skills.

doola is a dynamic company committed to simplifying the complexities of business formation, payment setup, compliance, taxes, and more. We empower entrepreneurs and businesses of all sizes to navigate the complex landscape of financial and regulatory requirements with ease, so they can focus on what truly matters: building and growing their ventures.

About Us

    doola's affiliate program partners with course creators, community owners, and coaches whose audiences need to form a business, think entrepreneurship educators, e-commerce coaches, and similar. Our affiliate revenue has been concentrated in a small number of high-performing partners, and we're hiring an Affiliate Manager to change that. This is a full-cycle, list-driven role: you'll build and continuously refine target lists of prospective affiliate partners to outbound against, own the relationship from first outreach through onboarding and first payment, and hand activated partners off to our Account Management team for ongoing support.

    Key Responsibilities

  • Build and refine target lists of prospective affiliate partners to outbound against, including a defined segment of affiliates who signed but never activated or have gone quiet
  • Own the full relationship from cold outreach through negotiation, onboarding, and first payment
  • Increase the number of active affiliates sending converting leads weekly, not just the total number signed
  • Re-engage dormant segments of your lists with updated & custom incentive structures
  • Hand off activated partners to our Customer Success team with clear documentation once onboarding is complete

    • Skills and Qualifications

  • 2+ years in affiliate management, partnerships, or creator partnerships
  • Demonstrated experience proactively recruiting and onboarding partners or affiliates, not just managing an existing book
  • Comfortable owning a relationship end-to-end: outreach, negotiation, and onboarding
  • Understanding of the info-business, course, or creator-economy space well enough to identify strong affiliate fits versus signups that won't activate
  • Comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook

Bonus Qualifications

  • Direct experience in the info-business, course, or creator-economy space
  • Familiarity with affiliate tracking platforms (e.g., PartnerStack or similar)
  • Experience negotiating performance-based or flat-fee incentive structures

Why Join Us

  • Build doola's affiliate motion from a list-driven, hands-on approach rather than inheriting an existing static book
  • Direct ownership over a revenue channel with real diversification upside for the business
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of the industry.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment with opportunities for growth and development.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from anywhere with a stable internet connection.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

If you are passionate about helping businesses succeed and thrive, and you possess the skills and experience outlined above, we want to hear from you! Join us at doola and be part of a team dedicated to simplifying the path to business success.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

You own growth for Engine's sports and wedding vertical, two of the most high-intent, high-value use cases in group travel. That means building the acquisition strategy from the ground up, finding the channels and programs that move the needle, and scaling what works. You'll bring a point of view, test it relentlessly, and turn what you learn into a repeatable growth engine.

This isn't just a channel management role. You'll shape how we acquire and retain customers, influence what we build for them, and help define what winning in this space looks like for Engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Acquisition Strategy: Identify the highest-leverage opportunities at the top of the funnel. Build the strategy, translate it into experiments, ship them fast, and scale what works. Digital, field events, referral programs, affiliate, community—nothing is off the table.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Product and Sales to identify what's holding us back from winning more wedding room blocks and help shape the roadmap to close those gaps. You'll bring the customer perspective and the market data.
  • Build Best-In-Class Lifecycle Programs: Partner with our lifecycle team to design end-to-end programs that transform the wedding customer experience, from the first touchpoint online to post-checkout. Every interaction should feel intentional and worth talking about.
  • Ship the Work: This is a hands-on role. Where you have the skills, execute directly. Where you don't, pull in the right people. You move fast, keep momentum, and don't wait for perfect.
  • Instrument and Learn: You track what matters, pull your own data, and use it to make sharper decisions. You build a learning culture around your experiments, wins and losses both.
  • AI-Native Growth: Engine's growth team uses AI as a core part of how we work. Leverage modern tooling to move faster, personalize at scale, and run more tests without depending on engineering or ops.

Qualifications

  • Strong growth marketing background with a track record of building and scaling acquisition programs across paid, organic, referral, field, or other channels
  • Experience running structured experimentation: hypothesis, test, learn, scale, and share your learnings. You don’t just stop when the experiment is done either. If you sees positive signal, you make the case to get more resources to grow.
  • Comfort with data. You pull your own analysis, build models, and back your strategy with numbers. Familiarity with tools like Amplitude, SQL, or similar is a plus
  • Strong cross-functional operator who knows how to work with Product, Design, and Lifecycle teams to get things built and shipped
  • AI fluency. You use AI to multiply your output, not as a novelty
  • High ownership mentality. You treat this vertical like a GM, not like a channel manager

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in B2C or marketplace growth where the buyer is high-intent and emotionally invested
  • Experience with paid media platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, or similar) and lifecycle or CRM platforms (Salesforce, Customer.io, Klaviyo, Braze, or similar)
  • 0-to-1 growth experience building something from early traction, not just managing at scale

Tech Stack

Salesforce, Claude, Amplitude, Customer.io, Outreach, Snowflake, SQL

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

$93,925—$130,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

raw.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

As a Staff Data Scientist at an early-stage, high-growth company, you'll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights and apps that shape strategy, fuel growth, and improve the customer experience. You'll have a direct hand in the decisions that move the business, not just the reports that describe it.

This isn't a "run the numbers and hand off a deck" role. You'll be partnering directly with senior leaders and an experienced data & analytics team to drive data science and experimentation initiatives across sales, marketing, and product areas — putting both traditional analysis and ML to effect change.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Architect optimization analyses and forecasts that help leaders pinpoint opportunities across Growth, Strategy, Revenue, Marketing, and Product teams.
  • Partner directly with executive leadership, translating complex analysis into clear, actionable decisions and process changes.
  • Design counterfactual analyses and A/B tests to enable data-driven evolution of our UX, product features and customer experience.
  • Build data apps that automate and supercharge our sales and marketing processes.
  • Own your projects end-to-end — from framing the business question to shipping the model to presenting the recommendation, with the autonomy to decide how you get there.
  • Work on top the same semantic layer and DBT models powering our AI-driven analytics stack (Snowflake Cortex, Sigma, Claude, etc.), so your analyses build on a single-source-of-truth data.
  • Create data science frameworks — templates and guides that data practitioners across the org can leverage and build upon.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • 7+ years of experience in data science in a fast-moving business setting, with a track record of running the show on ambiguous, high-stakes problems.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack — Snowflake, DBT, and various BI tools (Sigma, Looker, Metabase, Omni, or similar).
  • Strong SQL and statistical modeling skills, with a track record of building forecasting and causal inference models.
  • A love of documentation and Git — you enable others to build on top of your work..
  • You appreciate scalable data models — you contribute to the shared semantic layer, and let the whole org benefit.
  • You're just as excited to hack together a scrappy new analysis or app as you are to build scalable products that meet stringent quality standards.

Who You Are:

  • Self-driven and organized, with the ability to manage projects across cross-functional stakeholder groups with minimal oversight, keeping everyone updated on progress and next steps.
  • You don't wait for direction — you spot the opportunity, make the case, and drive it through.
  • An amazing communicator and presenter, equally comfortable in a room with executive leadership or heads-down in the data.
  • A true team player — you love brainstorming, peer reviews, and pressure-testing ideas.
  • You're in it for the journey, not just the destination.

Compensation Band: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years

Role Title: Marketing, Sales & Communications Expert — PowerPoint Review & Reconstruction

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Marketing, Sales & Communications Experts to contribute to a customer’s project focused on high-impact business presentations. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Receive images of business slides related to marketing, sales, and communications materials and reconstruct them in Microsoft PowerPoint.
  2. Elevate slides by enhancing visual design, data visualization, and storytelling while preserving factual accuracy and domain-specific definitions.
  3. Write a detailed log for each slide, clearly explaining both improvements made and intentional choices to preserve elements, defending strong original decisions as needed.
  4. Work with various presentation types, including campaign performance reviews, brand strategies, sales pitch decks, and executive board or investor communications.

  1. 3+ years of hands-on experience in marketing, brand, sales enablement, corporate communications, or relevant agency environments.
  2. Demonstrated expertise in building executive-level presentations for senior leaders or client stakeholders.
  3. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, including layout, visual hierarchy, and data visualization best practices.
  4. Strong critical thinking and attention to detail; able to articulate the rationale for both improvements and preserved elements.
  5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the capacity to explain messaging hierarchy and exhibit choices in a clear, concise manner.
  6. Direct industry or practitioner experience valued more than a consulting-firm background; both industry contributors and consultants are welcomed.
  7. Prior experience with AI training, evaluation, or rubric development is a plus, though not required.

Vehicle Operations

Job Profile

Fleet Services Advisor I

Management Level

Day

Compensation

Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $45,800.00 - $68,800.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.

Job Description

Are you a former technician, shop foreman, fleet maintenance professional, service advisor, or OEM warranty administrator looking to leverage your mechanical expertise without spending every day in the shop?

As a Fleet Service Advisor I, you'll serve as a trusted maintenance partner for commercial fleet customers, acting as an extension of their maintenance department. In this role, you will review repair recommendations, evaluate maintenance needs, authorize repairs, and help customers balance vehicle uptime, safety, and maintenance costs.

Using your mechanical expertise and sound judgment, you'll ensure repairs adhere to customer maintenance programs, OEM guidelines, and industry best practices while delivering an exceptional customer experience. Fleet Service Advisors work closely with repair facilities, technicians, vendors, and customers to make informed maintenance decisions, control costs, and minimize vehicle downtime.

This is an ideal opportunity for individuals with automotive, diesel, trucking, dealership, fleet maintenance, warranty administration, or service advising experience who want to transition their hands-on technical knowledge into a remote, office-based role while continuing to solve complex maintenance and repair challenges.

Work Schedule: This position supports a 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM Eastern Time shift.

Work Location: This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States. Qualified candidates will be considered regardless of geographic location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review repair estimates, diagnostics, and maintenance recommendations for commercial vehicles and equipment.

  • Evaluate repair needs based on customer maintenance policies, OEM guidelines, warranty considerations, and industry best practices.

  • Authorize repairs and maintenance services within established approval guidelines.

  • Analyze labor operations, parts requirements, and repair recommendations for accuracy, necessity, and cost effectiveness.

  • Utilize vehicle repair history, maintenance records, warranty information, parts pricing, labor standards, and repair best practices to support maintenance decisions.

  • Communicate with repair facilities, technicians, vendors, and customers to obtain diagnostic information and clarify repair recommendations.

  • Act as an advocate for customers by helping manage repairs on their behalf and ensuring service providers meet customer maintenance expectations.

  • Audit managed repairs and preventive maintenance inspections to ensure accuracy, validity, and compliance with customer standards.

  • Research maintenance history and prior repairs to support repair authorization decisions.

  • Assist in resolving invoice discrepancies, estimate variances, maintenance-related disputes, and billing concerns.

  • Support preventive maintenance program compliance and vehicle maintenance scheduling activities.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, service providers, and customers to minimize vehicle downtime and ensure timely repair completion.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of repair authorizations, recommendations, and case activity.

  • Deliver an exceptional customer experience through timely communication, quality service, and sound maintenance decision making.

  • Manage multiple repair cases simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of experience in fleet maintenance, diesel repair, automotive repair, warranty administration, service advising, vehicle maintenance operations, or a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as an associate degree and 2 years of experience; a bachelor's degree in a related discipline; or 8 years of related experience.

  • Strong working knowledge of automotive, diesel, or commercial vehicle maintenance and repair.

  • Ability to understand vehicle diagnostics, repair recommendations, and maintenance requirements.

  • Ability to interpret repair estimates, labor operations, parts requirements, maintenance recommendations, and warranty considerations.

  • Strong computer proficiency and ability to navigate multiple software systems simultaneously.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • High attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload while maintaining quality and customer service standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ASE Certification(s) or other industry-recognized maintenance certifications.

  • Experience supporting medium-duty and heavy-duty commercial fleets.

  • Experience in fleet management, transportation, trucking, dealership service operations, or OEM warranty administration.

  • Previous experience reviewing repair estimates, warranty claims, maintenance authorizations, or vendor invoices.

  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance programs, DOT compliance requirements, and OEM maintenance standards.

  • Previous mechanical training or hands-on technician experience.

Examples of Applicable Mechanical Knowledge

Successful candidates should be comfortable discussing and evaluating topics such as:

  • Preventive maintenance programs and service intervals.

  • Engine diagnostics.

  • Emissions systems and regeneration (DPF/regen) processes.

  • Cooling, fuel, braking, suspension, and electrical systems.

  • Labor operations and repair procedures.

  • OEM maintenance recommendations.

  • Warranty coverage and repair eligibility.

  • Parts pricing and repair cost analysis.

  • Vehicle inspection findings and maintenance requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Making sound maintenance authorization decisions that balance vehicle reliability, safety, and cost control.

  • Accurately evaluating repair recommendations and maintenance estimates from service providers.

  • Demonstrating strong mechanical judgment and problem-solving skills.

  • Maintaining thorough, accurate, and detailed case documentation.

  • Delivering timely and professional communication to customers and vendors.

  • Helping customers maximize vehicle uptime while controlling maintenance expenses.

  • Providing an exceptional customer experience and serving as a trusted maintenance resource.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has a strong mechanical background and enjoys solving technical problems in an office environment. They understand how vehicles operate, can evaluate repair recommendations with confidence, and are comfortable making decisions that balance vehicle uptime, maintenance costs, safety requirements, and customer expectations.

Former technicians, shop foremen, service advisors, fleet maintenance professionals, and OEM warranty administrators who are looking to apply their expertise in a consultative, customer-focused role are especially encouraged to apply.

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. Cox provides reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with disability, unless such accommodations would cause an undue hardship.EOE, including disability/vetsApplicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll design and build scalable systems using Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI, ML integration), and Angular — driving everything from backend architecture to UI design. You’ll work closely with product, data science, and design teams to deliver intelligent, seamless user experiences. You’ll lead code reviews, define best practices, shape deployment strategies on Azure, and help evolve our CI/CD and DevOps pipelines.

If you're eager to own the full stack, lead with technical depth, and build AI-powered systems that have real-world impact — let’s talk.

What You Will Do

    • Design, architect, and develop scalable end-to-end features using Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI, ML integration), and Angular
    • Collaborate closely with product, data science, and design teams to deliver intuitive, intelligent user experiences
    • Own and drive technical decisions — from API design to deployment strategies — with an eye on performance, reliability, and security
    • Lead code reviews, set engineering best practices, and establish a high-quality engineering culture
    • Work with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments Azure, and system observability
    • Influence product roadmap by bringing deep technical insights to planning conversations

What You Will Bring

    • Proficiency in:
      • Using AI tools like Cursor, Devin or Co-pilot to deliver efficiency
      • Java (Spring Boot, REST APIs, backend architecture)
      • Python (especially for microservices, API layers, or ML integration)
      • Angular (RxJS, Material, state management)
      • Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture (Azure)
      • Experience working in high-growth, agile environments with fast iteration cycles
      • Ability to balance tech leadership and hands-on coding
      • Bachelor’s degree or higher from IIT or other top- ranked schools

What Will Make You Stand Out

    • Experience working with Python, Angular/React,AI/ML pipelines, data engineering, or MLOps,

Why You Will Love It Here

  • Build game-changing AI tech: Engineer agent-based systems that predict and prevent real-world supply chain disruptions for industries like healthcare and aerospace.
  • Own the fullstack: Lead architecture and development using Java, Python, Angular, and Azure — with real influence on product and engineering decisions.
  • Code with purpose: Join a remote, mission-driven team where your work ensures critical goods reach people when and where they’re needed.

What's in it for you?

At Resilinc, we’re fully remote, with plenty of opportunities to connect in person. We provide a culture where ownership, purpose, technical growth and a voice in shaping impactful technology are at our core. Oh, and the perks? Full-stack benefits for health, wealth and wellbeing to keep you thriving. Check in with your talent acquisition contact for a location-specific FAQ.

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the Manager, Client Success – Strategic, you lead a team of Client Success Managers responsible for Rithum’s most strategic and highest-value client relationships. These accounts often include complex stakeholder groups, multi-product adoption, and sophisticated business requirements. You coach and support your team in driving value realization, retention, renewal, and growth while delivering an exceptional client experience. You partner across Rithum to resolve client needs and deliver strong outcomes across the portfolio.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use and encourage responsible adoption of AI to strengthen client insights, identify risks and opportunities, improve team productivity, and deliver more proactive client experiences.

Responsibilities

Strategic Client Outcomes

  • Guide CSMs in driving adoption, value realization, retention, and long-term success across strategic accounts.
  • Support CSMs in navigating complex client organizations and building strong executive and stakeholder relationships.
  • Manage client escalations and coordinate resources to resolve issues and protect client outcomes.
  • Monitor portfolio health and take action on client risks and opportunities.

Retention & Growth

  • Oversee renewal planning and execution across the team’s portfolio.
  • Partner with Sales to identify and support expansion opportunities aligned to client priorities.
  • Coach CSMs to connect success plans and demonstrated value to retention, renewal, and growth.
  • Use client and portfolio data to identify risks, opportunities, and appropriate actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Operational Excellence

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Services, Legal, Finance, and other teams to support client priorities, renewals, and growth.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to resolve client challenges and advance strategic priorities.
  • Share client feedback and emerging needs with relevant internal teams.
  • Reinforce consistent processes and responsible use of AI and automation to improve insights, productivity, and the client experience.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop CSMs supporting Rithum’s strategic clients.
  • Set clear expectations and coach the team on client engagement, success planning, value realization, renewal, and growth.
  • Manage performance and development through regular coaching, feedback, and accountability.
  • Foster a high-performing team focused on client value and business outcomes.
  • Responsible for hiring, building and leading teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Client Success, account management, renewals, or related client-facing roles in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • 1+ years of experience leading and coaching client-facing teams.
  • Experience supporting clients with at least $250K in annual recurring revenue (ARR), with complex stakeholder groups and business requirements.
  • Experience with renewals, client escalations, and expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales.
  • Strong communication, coaching, organizational, and cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Ability to use client and portfolio data to identify risks, opportunities, and actions.
  • Experience leveraging AI and technology to improve productivity, insights, or client outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Client Success, account management, renewals, or related client-facing roles.
  • Prior people management experience in Client Success or a related client-facing function.
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, e-commerce, marketplace, retail technology, or related environments.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Claude, Gainsight (and other Client Success platforms), and AI-enabled client or productivity tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $100,000-$168,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary.

  • A 6% 401(k) match
  • Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days

position

Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit, die den Überblick über unsere offenen Forderungen behält und Kunden professionell zur Zahlung führt – mit einer Prise Buchhaltungs-Know-how für angrenzende Themen.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:

You will own end-to-end accounting for revenue and partnership arrangements, ensuring accurate recognition, timely close, and complete disclosures across customer and partner incentives. You will maintain and improve internal controls and reporting, partner with commercial, legal, tax, and data teams to define accounting and control requirements, and support audits. You will identify, design, and implement AI and automation solutions — including generative models such as ChatGPT and Gemini — that reduce manual work, improve quality, and preserve human oversight, governance, and audit readiness.

What you'll work on:

  • Owning month-end and quarter-end close for revenue and partnerships, including subledger reviews, exceptions, journals and reconciliations

  • Analyzing balance sheet and P&L movements, investigating anomalies and producing evidence-based commentary on key drivers

  • Developing understanding of commercial economics, contract terms and data flows to ensure transactions are complete and accurately reflected

  • Reviewing customer and partner arrangements and applying ASC 606 and US GAAP to incentives, revenue sharing and non-standard terms

  • Designing and implementing AI-driven automation and process improvements using tools like ChatGPT and Gemini to reduce manual work while preserving human oversight and auditability

What you'll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements

  • 2+ years of relevant accounting or audit experience

  • Professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent)

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, especially ASC 606, with hands-on experience in revenue recognition, partner incentives, variable consideration and balance sheet reconciliations

  • Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with ERP systems and transaction subledgers (Oracle or similar) and month/quarter close activities

  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite

Responsibilities

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Overview:

Sargent & Lundy Consulting (SLC) works on behalf of clients to support electric power projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will help work on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, BESS, reciprocating engines, and other generating technologies with large dynamic electrical loads.

We are seeking a Controls & Grid Integration Planning Engineer to support Owner’s Engineer and design teams on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, reciprocating engines, BESS, Solar PV, with large dynamic loads. The role will provide independent technical oversight of plant control philosophies, ensuring that OEM, EPC, and system integrator designs collectively deliver stable, resilient, and compliant operation under steady-state, transient, and islanded conditions. The engineer will review and challenge dynamic studies, control narratives, plant controller strategies, and protection philosophies without directly performing detailed PSS®E or PSCAD modeling. Responsibilities include validating integration between GT controls, BESS EMS/PPC systems, SCADA, and overall coordination strategies (frequency response, voltage control, inertia management, black start, load rejection, and large motor/data center step loads).

The position requires strong cross-disciplinary leadership, risk identification capability, and the ability to translate complex control interactions into clear recommendations for owner and lender stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include engineering design reviews, technical due diligence, project development support, and conceptual design. Particular experience in electrical design of thermal power projects is desired.

You will have the opportunity to travel within the United States as well as internationally.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 12+ years’ experience in power generation controls, grid integration, or utility-scale plant systems
  • Demonstrated experience with islanded or isolated grids
  • Strong understanding of dynamic performance studies (transient stability, EMT, frequency response), even if not the primary modeler
  • Familiarity with gas turbine control systems (e.g., Mark VIe or equivalent) and BESS plant/energy management systems, power plant controllers
  • Experience reviewing EPC deliverables, grid code compliance documentation, and performance guarantees
  • Knowledge of protection coordination and system-level control architecture
  • Strong communication skills for engagement with developers, OEMs, lenders, and regulatory bodies
  • Experience in development support and conceptual design of thermal power projects:
    • Simple cycle gas turbines,
    • Combined cycle projects,
    • Coal fired generation, or
    • Reciprocating engines (RICE)

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering is a plus.
  • Experience in technical due diligence and owner’s engineering design reviews of thermal power projects is a plus.
  • General understanding of power station operations and performance reviews is a plus.
  • General understanding of process design at electric power generation facilities is a plus.
  • Contract development experience is a plus.
  • Reliability modeling experience is a plus.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: SAP HANA Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$125,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP HANA Consultant to design, build, and optimize HANA-native data models and analytical objects supporting S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, and standalone HANA platforms. In this role you will translate complex business and analytics requirements into performant HANA models, and you will be the go-to expert for diagnosing and resolving HANA performance issues across the SAP landscape. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in HANA-native modeling — including calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript — with strong performance-tuning skills and a clear understanding of HANA internals.

  • Solid understanding of HANA architecture, including in-memory storage, columnar processing, and parallel execution.
  • Hands-on experience with HANA performance tuning tools and methodologies.
  • Experience with HANA replication tools (SLT, SDI, SDA).
  • Working knowledge of HANA security models, including analytic privileges and roles.
  • Familiarity with S/4HANA embedded analytics or BW/4HANA modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP-certified HANA modeling or development credentials.
  • Experience with HANA Native Storage Extension or dynamic tiering.
  • Exposure to HANA Cloud and SAP Datasphere.
  • Familiarity with BTP-based analytics tooling such as SAC.

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

  • Job Description Summary

    This role leads corporate accounting and the company's international accounting operations across the Philippines, India and Hong Kong. The Director, Corporate Accounting owns the monthly, quarterly and annual close for the corporate and international entities, sets accounting policy under US GAAP, and is accountable for the accuracy, timeliness and auditability of consolidated financial reporting. The role carries direct responsibility for a multi-entity, multi-currency close, for the internal control environment supporting it, and for the external and statutory audit relationships in the assigned entities. Reporting to the Vice President, Accounting, the Director leads a four-country organization through a senior finance manager and accounting managers, and serves as the primary escalation point for accounting judgment across the corporate close.

  • Job Description

    Duties and Responsibilities

    • Own the monthly, quarterly and annual close for the corporate and international entities, including consolidation, intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and the consolidated reporting package.

    • Lead the international accounting organization across the Philippines, India and Hong Kong, including hiring, performance management, development, succession planning and workload balancing across time zones.

    • Establish, document and maintain accounting policy under US GAAP; independently research, conclude and memorialize technical accounting positions, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), business combinations and equity.

    • Prepare and review financial statements, footnote support and supporting schedules to public-company reporting standards, including the documentation and disclosure rigor expected of an SEC registrant.

    • Own the close calendar; drive reduction in days-to-close while improving accuracy and reducing post-close and audit adjustments.

    • Serve as the primary accounting contact for the external audit, and for statutory audits, filings and local compliance in each international jurisdiction; manage PBC delivery, issue resolution and remediation.

    • Design, document and operate internal controls over financial reporting for the corporate and international close; identify and remediate deficiencies and support SOX-readiness activities.

    • Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations and balance sheet flux analysis for owned entities; establish materiality and review thresholds.

    • Partner with Tax on the provision, transfer pricing and statutory reporting inputs, and with FP&A on variance analysis and management reporting.

    • Drive process standardization, automation and offshore capability build across the accounting organization in partnership with the Director, Financial Systems.

    • Prepare analysis, schedules and written commentary supporting the Audit and Risk Committee reporting cycle.

    • Represent Accounting in cross-functional initiatives including system conversions, entity rationalization, integration and other transaction-related activity.

    Minimum Qualifications

Description

With ride-hailing, on-demand delivery, and autonomous vehicles, options for transporting people and goods have never been so plentiful – or presented so many emerging risks. Drawing on Liberty’s vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions (LMMS) represents an underwriting model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the sharing economy and new mobility marketplace. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with actuarial, product development, client, and claims teams to deliver a robust insurance experience. Join our expanding underwriting team to foster change and innovation and partner with brokers and sharing economy and new mobility businesses to help this segment grow and thrive.

As an LMMS Underwriting Manager, you will manage a team of underwriting professionals responsible for renewing and pursuing opportunities to achieve a balanced, profitable, and quality book while protecting company assets. In some cases, the accounts worked may be among the largest risk transfer opportunities or renewals in the company, with complex risk sharing structures and evolving coverage language. Responsibilities include risk assessment, coverage and pricing analysis, broker/partner communication and management, and industry thought leadership. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills in order to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will develop and maintain effective business relationships with internal and external partners. You will apply an advanced level of expertise and judgment to evaluate scenarios, data, and recommendations prepared by underwriters, actuaries, and or cross-functional partners and provide guidance for risk selection and acceptance, coverage, and price for casualty business in select sharing economy and new mobility sectors.

Responsibilities:

  • Leadership:Responsible for the retention, acquisition, and development of senior level underwriting talent. Formally manage, guide, mentor, and coach underwriters in both technical and professional skills. Foster an environment conducive to innovation, continuous improvement and product development.
  • Risk Selection:Responsible for developing and implementing a strategy to better evaluate risk quality and further underwriters’ skillset in qualifying, selecting and assessing sharing economy and new mobility risks. In addition to managing staff, may also be responsible for underwriting complex accounts.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Establish and maintain high level of relationship management with key Agents and Brokers. Develop underwriters’ technical, negotiation, communication and general deal making skills.
  • Portfolio Management:Evaluate portfolio performance based on profitability metrics, evolving risk scenarios, outcome and volatility ranges, reinsurance, opportunity metrics, and industry trends. Define UW team execution strategy and oversee execution of continuously improving portfolio in alignment with team objectives. Be the lead custodial of capital for your team.
  • Quality Audit and Account Review:Collaborates with the LMMS SUO and the OOU to ensure files meet regulatory requirements and internal documentation standards. Coach underwriters to articulate thought process, decision making within both account reviews and file documentation.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:

raw.title: Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm.
raw.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

We put delivery dates in contracts and carry the overage risk ourselves. That only works if someone owns the delivery — scope, timeline, budget, and sprint execution and treats a slipping date as their problem, not a status-report line item. That someone is you.

As our Technical Project Manager, you'll run distributed engineering teams across India and three US time zones on customer engagements where the date is committed. You'll run the daily, sprint, and client cadences, translate fluently between engineering and business stakeholders, and push back on scope creep with data. Agents compress the repetitive engineering work, which makes delivery faster and makes your job sharper: shorter timelines leave no room for blockers that sit in a log for days. We're looking for the PM who gets things done who personally removes blockers, drives escalations to closure, and makes sure no risk reaches the client as a surprise.

This role is not for you if:

  • Your default is to forward messages between the client and engineering.
  • Your role has primarily been reporting and coordination without delivery ownership.
  • You've only facilitated agile ceremonies without driving delivery outcomes.
  • Sprint ownership and execution were largely driven by a Business Analyst or Product Owner in your previous roles.

What you will do

  • Build the project plan in Smartsheet from the Solutions Architect's scope of work, real dependencies, a defensible critical path, sprint boundaries overlaid on the timeline.
  • Track scope, hours, and budget in real time. Flag burn-rate risk early and push back on scope creep with numbers, not gut feel.
  • Maintain a live risk register. Spot risks before they become issues, surface the right ones to the client at the right time, and drive mitigation actively.
  • Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and an action tracker with clear ownership, accountability, and timely closure.
  • Run crisp daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives that produce decisions, not discussions.
  • Remove sprint blockers personally. Chase the client-side data dependency, escalate the stuck cloud permission, redirect pulled resources don't let "waiting on" sit in a log for days.
  • Handle sprint-level risks in real time: reprioritize, descope, swap stories, or escalate before commitments slip.
  • Keep trackers honest. Action items have owners and dates; delays are visible and followed up on time.
  • Translate technical progress into business language for the customer, and business priorities into clear, estimable requirements for engineers.
  • Facilitate internal and external architecture reviews across India and three US time zones; document decisions and circulate them the same day.
  • Produce weekly customer status updates a senior business leader can absorb in 90 seconds — RAG colors backed by evidence, not sentiment.
  • Own customer escalations and drive them to resolution. Communicate status, risks, and decisions needed — proactively, not reactively.
  • Onboard engineers on customer systems, scope, process, deliverables, and documentation standards.
  • Create kick-off presentations, project charters, and tracking mechanisms in collaboration with the customer.
  • Maintain meeting notes, recorded calls, and a clean project documentation library.
  • Review and approve timesheets and leaves; keep capacity planning and team calendar management accurate.
  • Negotiate scope changes with data. Produce formal change requests with impact analysis hours, timeline, trade-offs, options before anyone commits the team to additional work.
  • Drive sprint predictability with velocity planning and burndown tracking; commitments are realistic and consistently met.
  • Run backlog refinement with Principal Consultants or Technical Leads so stories are clear, prioritized, and estimable.

What are we looking for

  • 3+ years of delivery experience on cloud engineering or data engineering projects.
  • 3+ years as a Project Manager working with customers in US time zones.
  • Hands-on fluency with Smartsheet, Jira / Confluence, and Clockify — you can stand up the tooling on day one.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills — you can hold your ground with a skeptical client engineering director and coach a junior engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong prioritization and problem-solving instincts. You make trade-offs explicit rather than quietly absorbing them.
  • A demonstrable track record of driving outcomes, not just reporting on them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing at least one fixed-bid project from kickoff through closure, including scope change negotiation with clients.
  • A strong grasp of Agile delivery metrics — velocity, burndown, sprint predictability — and the ability to use them to drive execution.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where requirements evolve; you bring structure proactively.

You will be preferred if you posses

  • Experience managing Data Lake projects on AWS.
  • Professional Scrum Master™ (PSM) certification.
  • Managing Jira Projects certification.
  • Smartsheet certification.

How we work?

    Aedeon absorbs scale. Engineers absorb judgment. The contract absorbs risk fixed-date delivery, with Mactores covering overage cost for delays inside our control. You're the person who keeps those three honest on a live engagement: the plan defensible, the burn visible, the risks surfaced before they cost anything. Our engineers embed with the customer's team and carry the delivery commitment personally. You carry the date.

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliver value
10. Be collaborative
We would like you to read more details about the work culture on

The Path to Joining the Mactores Team

At Mactores, our recruitment process is structured around three distinct stages:

Pre-Employment Assessment:

A series of evaluations of your technical proficiency and suitability for the role.
Managerial Interview: The hiring manager engages with you in multiple discussions, 30 minutes to an hour each, covering technical skills, hands-on experience, leadership potential, and communication.
HR Discussion: During this 30-minute session, you'll have the opportunity to discuss the offer and next steps with a member of the HR team.
Mactores provides equal opportunities in all employment practices. We don't discriminate based on race, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other category protected by federal, state, and local laws. This applies to every part of the employment relationship, recruitment, compensation, promotions, transfers, disciplinary action, layoff, training, and social and recreational programs.
Note: Please answer as many questions as possible with this application to accelerate the hiring process.
